retained_findings: A consuming CSS Syntax section 4.3.13 operation is the correct primitive kind and value-unit owner for direct combinator grammar; it introduces no token tape, atom algebra, component-value aggregate, CST, lexer, scanner, cursor, or source-slicing runtime.

The frozen accepted-prefix language, maximal dot/exponent guards, number/integer type rule, sign rule, Object.is binary64 observation, exact ordinary three-key leaf, and UTF-16 extent observation are coherent with the pinned CSS algorithm and ECMAScript carrier boundary.

An independent transcription matched the declared maximal-prefix regex on all 299593 strings of lengths zero through six over +-.eE09x, and the public corpus covers the six number-start arms, nonzero offsets, incomplete tails, composition witnesses, and hostile linear-size inputs.
Reflect.ownKeys plus ordinary-prototype and data-descriptor checks correctly close exact semantic-leaf drift.
The local CSS, BBNF, parse-that, TypeScript, proof-input, compiler SourceFile, and clean-base closures are useful authenticated formation evidence.
The current sealed holdout's public receipt, 14-row precursor closure, canonical ciphertext, decoded envelope length, and magic were reproduced without plaintext or key access.

The candidate-only Williams schedule, paired log-ratio bootstrap, shared-index familywise statistic, and O(1) observer are reusable components after correctness, attribution, comparator, and lifecycle repair.
The five skeptic roles and three unanimous synthesis-adjudicator roles are retained as design law, but their names alone grant no admission or credit.
